description: same_person — a near-zero score (0.005) produced because the TREE CANDIDATE IS THIN: I1 is a local stub carrying one name and one fact, and the match engine scores on document content, so a sparse subject scores low against everything. The number is not a real mismatch signal and must not veto an overwhelming qualitative correlation — that guardrail is genuine and is what this fixture exists for. Its CAUSE was previously described as a missing FamilySearch ARK; that is refuted (dev/probe-same-person-local-id.ts: an ARK-less focus person scores 0.9999484 against a 0.999967 control), so an ARK-less or locally-minted id is scorable and is never an excuse to skip the call.
